_about: Fractal Audio firmware release notes quoted by the Ares note (docs/API.md §4.5). Fetched by tf-lead with the research User-Agent, one request each. Quotes are verbatim from the fetched pages after whitespace normalisation.

quotes: Removed the “Motor Drive” and “Transformer Grind” algorithms and associated parameters from the Amp block. These have been replaced by the new “Speaker Compression” algorithm.
The “Spkr Comp” parameter controls the amount of virtual speaker compression. This value defaults to 3.0 when the Amp block is reset.
If using the Axe-Fx II with a tube power amp and conventional guitar cab you may want to reduce this value to 0.0.
This firmware is a partial port of the “Ares” modeling used in the Axe-Fx III.
Not all aspects of the Ares modeling were able to be ported but the most important parts were and the amp modeling should sound very similar.
sources.note: The cumulative Axe-Fx II release notes on this page list Ares 1.00 directly above Quantum 10.01, so Ares carries the Quantum 9.00 Amp block change.
